sections.content: You know the simple future from A2 Unit 19, for events that will happen. New here: the future also expresses a guess about the present. *Estará en casa* means “He/she is probably at home”. The conditional does the same for a guess about the past: *Serían las ocho cuando llegó el tren* means “It was probably about eight when the train arrived”.

items.spanish: Estará en casa, pero no estoy seguro.
items.english: He/She is probably at home, but I am not sure.

items.spanish: Serán las ocho, porque ya hay mucha gente en la calle.
items.english: It is probably eight o'clock, because there are already many people in the street.

items.spanish: Serían las ocho cuando llegó el tren.
items.english: It was probably about eight when the train arrived.

items.spanish: El tren llegará tarde si hay problemas en la línea.
items.english: The train will arrive late if there are problems on the line.

items.spanish: Probablemente sucederá algo parecido el año que viene.
items.english: Something similar will probably happen next year.

sections.content: Remember: context tells you whether the future is a prediction about a later event or a guess about the present.
